tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (kha)༄༅/ /'jam dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po'i bstod pa sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/shrī dzñā
(kha)༄༅/ /'jam dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po'i bstod pa sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/shrī dzñā

tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// 'jam dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po'i bstod pa sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shrī dzñā na gu ṇa pha la nā ma stu tiḥ bod skad du/ dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po zhes bya ba'i bstod pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi blo gros sgrib gnyis sprin bral nyi ltar rnam dag rab gsal bas// ji snyed don kun ji bzhin gzigs phyir nyid kyi thugs kar glegs bam 'dzin// gang dag srid pa'i btson rar ma rig mun 'thums sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i// 'gro tshogs kun la bu gcig ltar brtse yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan gsungs// 'brug ltar cher sgrogs nyon mongs gnyid slong las kyi lcags sgrog 'grol mdzad cing*// ma rig mun sel sdug bsngal myu gu ji snyed gcod mdzad ral gri bsnams// gdod nas dag cing sa bcu'i mthar son yon tan lus rdzogs rgyal sras thu bo'i sku// bcu phrag bcu dang bcu gnyis rgyan spras bdag blo'i mun sel 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud// gang dag lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas gcig dang bdun dang nyi shu rtsa gcig dang*// brgya dang stong la sogs pa dag nyin re bzhin du sgrogs pa de ni go rim ji lta ba bzhin tu sgrib pa dag pa dang*/ thos pa 'dzin pa dang*/ spobs pa skye ba dang*/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob pa dang*/ phyir rgol ba thams cad 'joms pa'i shes rab kyi dbang po dang*/ stobs la sogs pa yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro// gang zhig nyin re bzhin du lan gsum du bstod pa de ni ji skad bshad pa'i yon tan de dag dang ldan pas shes rab dang*/ snying rjes lam dang sa rim gyis bgrod de gong du ches cher 'phar nas/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer du phyin nas 'gro ba ma lus pa sgrol ba'i ded dpon chen por 'gyur ro// dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po zhes bya ba'i bstod pa slob dpon rdo rje mtshon cha la zhal gzigs pa'i tshe yon tan ji lta bar bstod pa rdzogs so// sgyur byed dam pa rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po dang*/

chos kyi grags pa dang*/ tsan+d+ra go mī la sogs pa nas lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po yan chad du/ nyi shu rtsa gcig po kun gyis zhal gzigs shing dngos grub brnyes pa yin gsungs/ 'di dang 'grel pa sum cu pa gnyis rngog blo ldan shin tu rtsis che zhing phal dang phal la mi gnang bar mdzad do// ༈ /'jam dbyangs gang blo ma'i rjes gnang gi tho bzhugs so// swa sti/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa gang blo ma dang rjes su 'brel ba'i byin rlabs ni/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal la tshom bu gcig bkod/ mchod pa 'khor mor bya/ gtor ma gcig bsham/ tshom bu'i steng du 'jam dpal bskyed la mchod bstod bya/ gtor ma 'bul/

'di la slob dpon rang gis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed chos kyi bdag med bsgom/ gnas gsum yi ge gsum dang*/ snying gar zla ba la dhīḥyig bkod la sngags bzla/ mdun du stong pa'i ngang las pad ma dang zla ba'i gdan bskyed pa rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ ma lus sems can sogs kyis 'jam dpal ye shes pa spyan drangs gdan phul zhal phyag gsal gdab/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab/ rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab gsungs/ rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro rnams spyi dang mthun par mdzad/ de nas me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rgyun bshags kyang mdzad/ slob dpon la mos gus drag tu byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de nas de'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab pa stsal du gsol snyam pas/ brtse ldan khyod kyi shes rab 'od zer gyis sogs kyis gsol ba lan gcig btab/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas bstod pa'i tshig dang byin rlabs ma lus pa byung nas rang la thim par bsams la/ gang gi blo gros tshar gcig oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes tshar bdun gyi rjes zlos bya/ nyer gcig kyang bshad/ slar yang de bzhin te gsum bya'o// rjes la/ gtso bos sogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs bya/ 'di bsgrubs pa las byung ba yi// dge ba bdag gis gang bsags pa// des ni skye bo thams cad kyis// bde gshegs shes rab thob par shog /ces sogs bsngo smon bya'o// rje bla ma tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'jam dbyangs gang blo ma'i rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog ces bya ba bzhugs so// ma rig mun pa sel ba dang*// shes rab snang ba rgyas pa'i phyir// bla ma rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la// btud nas de yi rjes gnang bri// 'jam dbyangs gang blo ma'i rjes gnang bya ba'i tshul ni/

mdun du stegs kyi steng maṇ+ḍal la tshom bu gcig bkod/ de'i mdun du gtor ma gcig dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro nyer spyod bkod mdzes su bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu me tog gi snod/ slob ma la bkye rgyu'i maṇ+ḍal nas dang bcas pa bshams nas/ stan bde ba la 'khod de khrus dang gtsang sbra dang ldan pas/ mchod pa rnams oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs dril bu dkrol te byin dbab/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs skyabs 'gro ci nus dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bstod sgrub nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ oṃ swa bhā ba zhes sogs kyis chos kyi bdag med bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying ga'i stod du hūm̐/ dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥyig dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa gsal bar dmigs te/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ dpe la lar hūm̐ swā hā zhes pa'ang snang*/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs bzlas mthar gsol ba gdab/ de nas mdun gyi tshom bu a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las tshom bu'i steng pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'jam dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ pad zla'i steng du bzhugs pa ni rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs sku mdog gser btso ma ltar 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ḥ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ ār+ya mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba sogs sh+lo ka gcig gis bstod/ de nas gtor ma chu gtsang gis bran/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur pa bsam/ oṃ ār+ya mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ gong ltar mchod bstod bya/ de nas 'jam dpal de'i thugs ka'i dhīḥlas mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs thams cad stsol bar bsam pa'i mos gus drag pos thal mo sbyar te/ gang gi blo gros sgrib gnyis sprin bral nyi ltar rnam dag rab gsal bas// ji snyed don kun ji bzhin gzigs phyir nyid kyi thugs kar glegs bam 'dzin// gang dag srid pa'i btson rar ma rig mun 'thums sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i// 'gro tshogs kun la bu gcig ltar brtse yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan gsungs// 'brug ltar cher sgrogs nyon mongs gnyid slong las kyi lcags sgrog 'grol mdzad cing*// ma mig mun sel sdug bsngal myu gu ji snyed gcod mdzad ral gri bsnams// gdod nas dag cing sa bcu'i mthar son yon tan lus rdzogs rgyal sras thu bo'i sku// bcu phrag bcu dang bcu gnyis rgyan spras bdag blo'i mun sel 'jam dbyangs khyod la 'dud// ces tshar gsum brjod/

oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nyer gcig dmigs pa de dang ma bral bas bstod pa tshar gsum/ sngags nyer gcig yang bstod pa tshar gsum/ sngags nyer gcig yang bstod pa tshar gsum gyi mthar rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis bdag la blo gros kyi snang ba dpag tu med pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba 'debs pa rnams slob dpon gyi bya ba'o// de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes/ 'o/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can zhes sogs sems bskyed gsal btab/ chos bshad rgyas bsdus ji rigs sngon du btang nas/ de la 'dir skabs su babs pa ni/ gang blo ma'i bstod sgrub la rten nas 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la thog mar lo rgyus cung zad cig bsnyad na/ sngon dus su dpal na len+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang du paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje mtshon chas mkhan po mdzad cing bstan pa skyong ba'i dus na/ gnas der 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi lha khang zhig gsar du bzhengs pa la sang nyin rab gnas zhal bsro mdzad rgyu'i nub mo mkhan pos paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya la sang nyin 'jam dpal gyi stod pa re brtsams la khyer shog gsungs pa na/ de nub paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis mkhan po'i bka' bzhin so sor 'jam dpal la bstod pa re brtsams te phul ba na/ thams cad gros btab pa ltar bstod pa 'di kho na byung bas/ 'jam dpal nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs te gsungs par yid ches pas bstod pa yon tan bzang po zhes bya bar mkhan po nyid kyis mtshan byang btab nas byin rlabs shin tu che bar grags pa dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ bya rgyud rang rkang gi lugs ltar mdun gyi tshom bu'i steng du lha bskyed de/ de la mchod bstod dngos grub zhu ba/ gtor ma 'bul ba rnams sngon du song nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar slob dpon 'jam dpal dbyangs su mos pa mdzad nas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/

zhes 'bul du gzhug de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du mdun du rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags bya snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ de nas mdun gyi 'jam dpal la mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs rgyud bskul nas sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ brtse ldan khyod kyi shes rab 'od zer gyis// bdag blo'i gti mug mun pa rab bsal nas// bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung lugs rtogs pa yi// blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang rnams 'jam dpal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ral gri dang pusti 'dzin pa dran tsam mdzod/ mdun gyi 'jam dpal gyi thugs ka nas bstod pa sngags dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi rnam par byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas mar zhugs/ blo gros phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsam nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang gi blo gros nas 'dud kyi bar/ mdun gyi rje btsun gyi thugs ka'i dhīḥyig las sngags phreng byung khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar dhīḥbakod pa la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan nyer gcig mdzad par zhu/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de 'dra ba lan gsum du bya dgos pas slar yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ brtse ldan khyod kyi sogs nas sngags kyi rjes zlos bar sngar bzhin dang*/ slar yang de 'dra ba tshar gcig ste lan gsum bya/

mthar rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la me tog phul bar mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum brjod/ mdun gyi 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi phyag gi me tog khyed rang rnams kyi mgo thog tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la sogs tshar gsum brjod/ des rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi drung du byin rlabs bstod bsgrubs bgyis pa'i dge ba sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo bar bgyi'o// snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'di bsgrubs pa las byung ba yi// dge ba bdag gis gang bsags pa// de yis skye bo thams cad kyis// bde gshegs shes rab thob par shog /ces brjod/ gnas skabs de dag tu thob pa'i dam tshig bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams sogs brjod/ des 'jam dpal gang blo mar grags pa'i rjes gnang bya rgyud rang rkang gi lugs ltar gsan pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di ni rig pa mchog gi rgyud las/ gsung rab kyi gdod du bzlas lung gsum bya/ zhes sogs kyi don yin pas gzhan gyis bsre slad mi bya/ bla ma slob ma gnyis ka lhar dran tsam las lhar bskyed mi dgos gsungs so// rjes mdun bskyed la mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ tshom bu'i steng gi lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ bsngo smon shis brjod bya'o// de ltar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs gang blo ma'i// rjes gnang bya tshul bya rgyud rang rkang ltar// legs par bshad pas rgyud sder spyan yangs pa'i// mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams dgyes pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i zin tho dang*/

khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen pos mdzad pa'i zin tho gnyis gung bsgrigs nas lag len shin tu bde bar/ na tshod rgan yang blo gros gzhon nur gyur pa shāka btsun lhun grub kyis dben gnas rmor dgon par bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni lho brag pa bka' bcu kun bsam gyis bgyis pa 'dis kyang chos tshul 'di'i bka' mi nub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ma ma pra dzñā war+dha sid+dhim+me pra yats+tshan+tu maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod sgrub zab mo nyams su len tshul 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ blo ldan gang zhig mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi yon tan mtha' dag gi rtsa bar gyur pa dri ma med pa'i shes rab phun sum tshogs par bya ba'i slad du/ grub pa'i slob dpon rdo rje mtshon chas mdzad pa'i dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po'i bstod pa'i sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ sngon du brgyud ldan gyi bla ma las 'di'i rig gtad legs par nos te/ nges 'byung dang snying rje chen po'i blo shugs drag tu skyed bzhin pa'i ngang nyams len gyi rim pa la 'jug par bya'o// de la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba skyabs sems ni/ bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub bar du bla ma mchog gsum skyabs su bsnyen// gzhan don rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob phyir 'jam dpal bstod sgrub nyams blangs mthus// yid can bde ba rgyur bcas dang ldan sdug bsngal rgyur bcas kun dang bral// sdug bsngal med pa'i bde dang mi 'bral btang snyoms ngang la gnas gyur cig /lan gsum/ dngos gzhi sgom bzlas ni/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shud+dho3haṃ/ 'di ltar dngos kun bdag dang phung po rnam rig spros pa las 'das kyang*// rten cing 'brel 'byung snang cha 'gag med sgyu ma'i tshul la snyoms 'jug bzhin// rang gi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang snying dbus zla steng dhīḥyig las// 'phros pa'i 'od kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nu ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te// mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa ni// gur gum mdangs can brgyad gnyis lang tshor mtshan dpe'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar// gnag snum dbu skra zur phud lnga ldan snyan gong ut+pal chun pos mdzes// phyag g.yas ye shes ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon pas sher phyin glegs bam bsnams// sna tshogs dar dang rin chen rgyan spras zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs dbus zla steng dhīḥyig dmar ser 'bar bas mtshan// slar yang 'od 'phros dbang lha spyan drangs ye shes bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur bas// sku gang sgrib dag mi bskyod dbur brgyan gus pas bstod cing gsol btab mthus// thugs srog nyid las bstod pa'i tshig dang sngags kyi phreng ba bar med 'phros// nyin mor byed pas 'od ltar gsal ba bdag gi snying dbus thim pa'i mod// mi shes mun pa mtha' dag bsal nas mkhyen brtse nus pa'i snang ba yis// rig dang brtse ba'i pad+mo rab rgyas 'jam mgon go 'phang thob par gyur// ces brjod cing bsam la/

gang gi blo gros sgrib gnyis sprin bral nyi ltar rnam dag rab gsal bas// ji snyed don kun ji bzhin gzigs phyir nyid kyi thugs kar glegs bam 'dzin// gang dag srid pa'i btson rar ma rig mun 'thums sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i// 'gro tshogs kun la bu gcig ltar brtse yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan gsungs// 'brug ltar cher sgrogs nyon mongs gnyid slong las kyi lcags sgrog 'grol mdzad cing*// ma mig mun sel sdug bsngal myu gu ji snyed gcod mdzad ral gri bsnams// gdod nas dag cing sa bcu'i mthar son yon tan lus rdzogs rgyal sras thu bo'i sku// bcu phrag bcu dang bcu gnyis rgyan spras bdag blo'i mun sel 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud// lan gsum/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ

dpe la lar hūm̐ swā hā zhes snang na'ang dpe rnying phal cher du dkyus su bkod pa bzhin no// nyer gcig slar yang de 'dra tshar gnyis te bstod pa dgu phrugs su bya ba'am/ bstod pa bdun nam nyer gcig sogs kyi mthar bzlas pa ci nus su bya ste/ rgyun du 'di tsam gyis don 'grub la/ bstod sgrub dmigs bsal byed na/ ji skad bshad pa'i rim pas bstod pa khri phrag bdun bzla bar phan yon gyi mchan rnying las bshad la/ sngags 'bum phrag lnga'am bdun bzla'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ bstod pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ brtse ldan smra ba'i nyi ma khyod kyi mkhyen rab thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis// bdag blo'i nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gti mug mun pa rab gsal nas// legs gsung bka' dang dgongs 'grel bstan bcos gzhung lugs ji bzhin rtogs pa yi// blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba bskyed nas kun mkhyen thob par mdzad du gsol// zhes 'dod don la rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab/ mdun gyi lha rang la bstim pa'am mi dmigs par bsams nas bdag med gnyis kyi nges pas drangs pa'i zhi lhag zung 'jug gi ngang du ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag de las ldang ba na/ dge ba 'di yis tshogs gnyis sbyor bas bdag med don la gsal snang thob// de mthus spros bral 'jam dpal ye shes 'phags blos mngon sum nyid du mthong*// kun brtag lhan skyes nyon mongs rnam spangs rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// shes bya'i sgrib pa cha bcas mthar byas bde gshegs shes rab thob par shog /ces bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug thun mtshams rnams su'ang stong nyid snying rje'i snying po dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas spyod lam thams cad don yod par bya ste/ de ltar 'bad pas ring por mi thogs par srid zhi'i mtha' las 'das pa'i 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// zhes pa'ang mang du thos pa'i btsun pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos rang gzhan rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas yig rnying mtha' dag gi don gyi bcud phyung ste sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos rje bla ma ā nan+da mañdzu gho ṣas mdzad pa ste/

'dis kyang 'gro kun so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i ye shes la dbang 'byor ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ ༈ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod sgrub zab mo'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs blo gros snang ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang rdo rje mtshon cha 'bum phrag gsum pa rngog lo che// rin chen grags dang byang chub grags pa chos seng brtson 'grus seng ge'i zhabs// dar ma seng ge 'jam dpal rdo rje dar tshul bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal// rin chen seng ge bu ston yab sras bkra shis rin chen ngor chen rje// grags rgyal legs 'byung kun dga' bsod nams dkon mchog lhun grub bud+dha'i mtshan/ sangs rgyas seng ge /nam mkha' dpal bzang nam mkha' sangs rgyas bsod mchog bka' 'gyur ba/ rin chen rgya mtsho dang*// phyogs las rnam rgyal kun dga' lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas kun blo'i zhabs// bstan pa'i nyi ma 'jam dpal gzhon nu ngag dbang rdo rje rin chen sogs// dngos brgyud dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la mi phyed gus pas gsol 'debs shing*// 'jam mgon bsngags pa'i nor bu'i rgyud mangs dad gsum sor mos bskul ba las// gnas skabs phyi nang rig gzhung rgya mtshor blo gros snang ba rgyas pa dang*// mthar thug srid zhi'i mtha' las 'das pa'i kun mkhyen ye shes thob byin rlobs// zhes pa'ang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos so// maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
